title: Cauliflower Au Gratin
method: Boil the cauliflower in rapidly boiling salted water until just tender.
Melt the butter and stir in the flour – cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove pan from the heat and gradually stir in the milk.
Bring to the boil and stir until it thickens.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Drain cauliflower and place in ovenproof dish.
Pour sauce over and sprinkle rest of cheese over top.
Place under a hot grill until brown.
notes: Try using parmesan as the cheese over the top.
Try cheddar and ricotta for the sauce.
